reason: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and it isn't even open yet. I'd have to go often to make $49 to $59 a month worth it, and we already do free playdates and church meetups.
objection: The drive and the gas. A monthly membership only pays off if we go a lot, and I can't see us making that trip every week with a baby and a 4-year-old.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it open and getting good reviews from other moms in my group, plus a free trial visit or a group rate for the meetups I organize so I'm not paying alone.
